_comment: Chosen candidate per subject, per batch. The record of what was picked and why a given PNG is in public/. Re-runnable: scripts/build-scenery.mjs reads this, so reinstalling is never a manual copy.

_dropped.cloud-3.dark: Removed 2026-08-08. Both candidates read as jellyfish/mushrooms rather than thunderheads — the 'towering' prompt pulled the shape into a stalk with a canopy.
_dropped.cloud-3: Dropped with its counterpart. A day cloud with no .dark variant falls back to itself on Storm Watch, i.e. a bright white cloud in a storm. Two fully-paired shapes beats three half-paired ones.
